scope: Selectable backend baseline plans; a plan is not acceptance evidence or coverage of all account types and configuration modes.
renewal_rule: Refresh includes OAuth grants, service-session reauthentication, library authorization renewal and SDK credential reacquisition where supported. Unknown applicability blocks complete qualification. Auth modes with no automatic renewal still require expiry/revocation denial and explicit recovery cases.

renewal_modes.auth_mode: account shared key / emulator shared key

renewal_modes.auth_mode: SAS URL / static key or SAS connection string

renewal_modes.auth_mode: explicit Entra client secret/certificate or service-principal file

observe token reacquisition for that provider
